Entities / Factions / The Passage

The Passage

A rattkin network formed from the Warren in 1240 DR to evade colonial pressure from the Tessarine Concordat and Dravosi Crown.

“Friend of the Passage — any Kin in need can ask.” Beaumont granted Perrin this status after the Saltwright boarding.

See Rattkin for species traits, varieties, and in-group terms. In Passage vocabulary, Kin means rattkin, Dry means non-rattkin, a Run is a local port network, and a Hold is a waypoint or safe house.

The Passage moves people, cargo, and information across routes that do not appear on colonial charts. Its knowledge is institutional: which harbor wall has a crawlspace, which dock beam carries a warning mark, which clerk can be relied on, which tide opens a low tunnel, which names carry risk in a port.

Structure

  • The Run — travelling families and crews whose circuit knowledge passes through generations, encoded in scratch-notation on bone and ceramic shards legible only to Kin.
  • The Hold — caches and shelters inside drainage channels, dock supports, wall cavities, old foundations, roof voids, cisterns, and forgotten city spaces.
  • The Tangle — seven senior elders governing the Calveno Run and the Passage’s most sensitive routing intelligence.

Nona Black-Jaw leads the Black-Jaw Run, the Warren’s anchor Run. Enzo executes her directives. Ruk handles kitchen security. Cobb operates the La Vasca dry dock under Black-Jaw colors.

One Law

The Passage does not move people in bondage. Cargo can be hidden, messages carried, and people smuggled to freedom. Enslaved people are not a trade good the Passage will handle. The Grung Clans’ coastal raiding and bondage practices are treated as a hard line; the Passage does not operate where Grung hold routes.

Session Events

  • Session 03: Nona called off the attacks on Perrin when he arrived in her kitchen — she’d believed he was captured. Anzolo was already in motion before the directive reached him; his status is unconfirmed. Perrin owes Nona a favor (terms unstated).
  • Session 04: Nona called in the favor — sent the party to investigate Grung sightings in the Warren tunnels and sewers. Provided Hero’s Feast, a map with 3 sighting locations, and a Rattkin eyewitness. Party exposed a coordinated Grung bombing plot: 4 attack points, black powder scaffolded against sewer ceilings, 2-day deadline timed to the festival. One ship destroyed, one purple handler killed, Felix Aho captured as informant. Nona received the prisoner and intel at her safe house. Sent Enzo with reinforcements after the sending stone report. The Passage now holds actionable intelligence on an unprecedented foreign military operation inside Calveno.
DM Note

The Passage faces a defining decision: handle the Grung threat through shadow channels (preserve operational secrecy) or break protocol to warn Calveno openly (permanently change the Passage’s relationship with the city). Nona’s response to the bombing intel will shape this faction’s trajectory. The organizational structure — how many cells, what geographic reach, who sits above Nona — is not established. Expand before the network becomes plot-relevant.

DM Notes — Calder’s Tooth Infrastructure

The Passage has turned the limestone cave systems under the Overland Track on Calder’s Tooth into a blind spot beneath Crown administration.

Overland Track — Hidden Route: Rattkin couriers cross the island in approximately 6 hours unseen through parallel dry-routes — bypasses toll stations, patrol eyes, cargo counts, and anyone waiting with a ledger. The Crown owns the official road. The Passage effectively owns the passage beneath it.

Osha’s Slip — Landing Site: The Passage’s favored night-landing site for small high-value cargo. The mud makes Dravosi armored pursuit nearly impossible. Crown authority at Osha’s Slip is largely theoretical.
